text:
tina: New hire on Win11 hit a weird failure in quickstart: `redwoodctl login --headless` opens the embedded WebView2 window and then nothing. CLI waits and never sees the callback.

lucas: what do the logs say?

tina: just `waiting for callback at http://127.0.0.1:12345` forever. Browser shows "Navigation canceled" in WebView2 devtools. External browser works if I copy the URL.

priya: WebView2 blocks cross-origin redirect to localhost in some corp policies. We default to the system browser embed which is convenient but brittle.

lucas: we have a flag `--open-in-browser` to force external browser, but quickstart doesn't mention it. Also on Windows the installer postinstall text says "run redwoodctl init" and doesn't call out `--profile quickstart` so people end up with default profile.

tina: user was confused because sample app used `quickstart` profile and they had `default`. Two separate UX leaks.

priya: quick fixes: 1) update installer message to recommend `redwoodctl init --profile quickstart` and `redwoodctl login --headless --open-in-browser` for Windows, 2) add a doctor check for WebView2 presence/policy and print the hint, 3) on embedded-webview failures detect navigation canceled and suggest `--open-in-browser` or device-code fallback.

lucas: agree. Also make retries less noisy when waiting for callback (show a single spinner line and a one-line actionable hint after 10s).

infra-bot: ci-check: docs branch `devex/win-webview2-hints` lint OK

tina: Also calls out `--trust-local-ca` as a dev-only option in case corp TLS inspection causes the embedded browser to be intercepted. Make sure it's session-scoped only.

priya: Will open PRs: 1) docs/postinstall text, 2) CLI doctor + embedded-webview detection, 3) small CLI UX: spinner and backoff. Tagging devex and eng-infra.

lucas: Thanks, will review. :thumbsup:
